groups.root_cause: Digest review-work detection ignores PR observation events, so new pushes after an acknowledged approval are missed.
Awaiting-review count doesn't exclude PRs with an in-progress change round.
Awaiting-review logic requires a saved head observation to honor an approval, so approvals recorded before any snapshot are treated as missing.
Status derivation ignores the run's confirmed merge flag.
Status precedence checks a historical blocked land before the PR's closed state.
Unrequested publication-gate change treats text needing exactly the max decode rounds as private, even with an empty denylist.
When the privacy policy can't be read, output is fail-closed too broadly, so MCP tool responses (including status state/next action and mutation results) are withheld.
Private-output filtering does substring matching on any registered credential with no minimum length, so whole fields and keys get withheld.
Digest fetches run detail and land state one run at a time with no limit, for every distinct run in the unread feed, inside the SessionStart hook.
Land queue lookup for an unknown run throws a generic error and doesn't map to a 404.
The MCP review-approval path hardcodes the reviewer as "human" instead of identifying the agent.
Digest caps how many lines it prints but not how long each line is, so long untrusted text goes out in full.
